the fee levied for reproducing folder content for a requester
the rejection of a request because the requester lacks a lawful basis
the register in which every disclosure of folder content is entered
items.s: Release log: the register in which every disclosure of folder content is entered. The other options describe Subpoena, Refusal, Copying charge.

items.q: The correct meaning of Duty roster is
o: the timetable showing which officer covers each shift
the ordered path of tasks that a folder follows through the department
the introductory training given to a new officer on taking up a post
the body of clinicians and filing staff that sets policy on the jacket service
items.s: Duty roster: the timetable showing which officer covers each shift. The other options describe Work flow, Induction, Records committee.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Colour banding?
o: shelving folders in strict ascending order of their whole numbers
a written inventory of the folders that should occupy a given stretch of shelving
shelving by a pair of digits taken from the centre of the number
the use of coloured strips on folder edges so that a misfile shows at a glance
items.s: Colour banding: the use of coloured strips on folder edges so that a misfile shows at a glance. The other options describe Shelf list, Middle digit filing, Straight numeric filing.

items.q: The correct meaning of Pre-admission is
o: the booking of a patient's stay in advance so that papers are ready on arrival
the abbreviated capture of identity for a patient too ill to answer questions
the relative named by a patient to be contacted in an emergency
the check made against existing names and numbers before a new folder is opened
items.s: Pre-admission: the booking of a patient's stay in advance so that papers are ready on arrival. The other options describe Emergency registration, Next of kin, Patient search.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the officer who records a patient into a bed and opens the inpatient papers”
o: Admission clerk
Registration
Duplicate patient record
Means of identification
items.s: Admission clerk is the officer who records a patient into a bed and opens the inpatient papers.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the number of beds officially available for use in a unit”
o: Turnover interval
Daily ward return
Bed days
Bed complement
items.s: Bed complement is the number of beds officially available for use in a unit.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Insurance claim form.
o: the document an insurer requires before it settles the cost of care
the rejection of a request because the requester lacks a lawful basis
a court's written command to produce documents or attend as a witness
the interval between receiving a request and dispatching the answer
items.s: Insurance claim form: the document an insurer requires before it settles the cost of care. The other options describe Turnaround time, Refusal, Subpoena.

items.q: The correct meaning of Form inventory is
o: the measure of how full the jacket has grown before another one must be started
the numbered and approved issue of blank documents so that none are unofficial
the register listing every blank document in use with its stock number
the layout of a blank document so that entries are easy to make and read
items.s: Form inventory: the register listing every blank document in use with its stock number. The other options describe Form design, Form control, Folder volume.

items.q: The correct meaning of Corrective action is
o: the change made to work routine after an audit reveals a shortfall
the examination of entries by another clinician of similar standing
the check that every required sheet and signature is present in a folder
a folder still incomplete after the permitted time following discharge
items.s: Corrective action: the change made to work routine after an audit reveals a shortfall. The other options describe Peer review, Quantitative analysis, Delinquent record.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Release log.
o: a court's written command to produce documents or attend as a witness
the register in which every disclosure of folder content is entered
the patient's signed agreement that named content may be given out
the document an insurer requires before it settles the cost of care
items.s: Release log: the register in which every disclosure of folder content is entered. The other options describe Consent to disclose, Subpoena, Insurance claim form.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Admission and discharge register?
o: the count of inpatients occupying beds at a fixed hour
the grouping of discharged cases by recorded condition for reporting
the share of available bed days actually used by patients
the ledger in which every entry to and exit from a bed is written in date order
items.s: Admission and discharge register: the ledger in which every entry to and exit from a bed is written in date order. The other options describe Occupancy rate, Census, Diagnosis tabulation.

items.q: The correct meaning of Serial unit numbering is
o: the practice of giving one number that follows a patient through every attendance
an extra figure calculated from the others so that keying errors are detected
the practice of issuing new numbers but gathering all earlier folders beneath the newest
the practice of issuing a new number each time the patient attends
items.s: Serial unit numbering: the practice of issuing new numbers but gathering all earlier folders beneath the newest. The other options describe Check digit, Serial numbering, Unit numbering.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “a marker left on the shelf in place of a folder that has been removed”
o: Reconstruction
Out-guide
Missing folder
Folder tracking
items.s: Out-guide is a marker left on the shelf in place of a folder that has been removed.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Induction?
o: the timetable showing which officer covers each shift
the ordered path of tasks that a folder follows through the department
instruction given to serving staff to improve their current duties
the introductory training given to a new officer on taking up a post
items.s: Induction: the introductory training given to a new officer on taking up a post. The other options describe Duty roster, Work flow, In-service training.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Form control.
o: the removal of superseded sheets from a bulky folder while the essential content stays
the clip or prong that holds the sheets so that none can slip out
the numbered and approved issue of blank documents so that none are unofficial
the measure of how full the jacket has grown before another one must be started
items.s: Form control: the numbered and approved issue of blank documents so that none are unofficial. The other options describe Fastener, Folder volume, Thinning.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Middle digit filing.
o: the pile of folders waiting to be returned because staff are short
the use of coloured strips on folder edges so that a misfile shows at a glance
shelving by a pair of digits taken from the centre of the number
the arranging of a batch of folders into shelf order before they are replaced
items.s: Middle digit filing: shelving by a pair of digits taken from the centre of the number. The other options describe Sorting, Colour banding, Filing backlog.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Charge-out?
o: the log that states where a removed jacket currently is at any moment
a marker left on the shelf in place of a folder that has been removed
the formal lending of a folder to a person or unit who signs for it
one not returned by the date recorded at charge-out
items.s: Charge-out: the formal lending of a folder to a person or unit who signs for it. The other options describe Overdue folder, Out-guide, Folder tracking.

items.q: In this course, Thinning refers to
o: the measure of how full the jacket has grown before another one must be started
the numbered and approved issue of blank documents so that none are unofficial
the fixing of all papers belonging to one patient into the jacket in an agreed sequence
the removal of superseded sheets from a bulky folder while the essential content stays
items.s: Thinning: the removal of superseded sheets from a bulky folder while the essential content stays. The other options describe Folder assembly, Folder volume, Form control.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the practice of issuing a new number each time the patient attends”
o: Family numbering
Alphabetic numbering
Serial numbering
Re-numbering
items.s: Serial numbering is the practice of issuing a new number each time the patient attends.

items.q: In this course, Overdue folder refers to
o: one that cannot be found after a search of the shelves and loan records
the log that states where a removed jacket currently is at any moment
one not returned by the date recorded at charge-out
the rebuilding of a lost folder from ward copies, results and other sources
items.s: Overdue folder: one not returned by the date recorded at charge-out. The other options describe Missing folder, Reconstruction, Folder tracking.

items.q: “the share of available bed days actually used by patients” is the definition of
o: Admission and discharge register
Occupancy rate
Bed complement
Census
items.s: Occupancy rate is the share of available bed days actually used by patients.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the selection of a part of the folders so that conclusions can be drawn about all”
o: Qualitative analysis
Quantitative analysis
Corrective action
Sampling
items.s: Sampling is the selection of a part of the folders so that conclusions can be drawn about all.

items.q: In this course, Number label refers to
o: the practice of issuing new numbers but gathering all earlier folders beneath the newest
the practice of issuing a new number each time the patient attends
the practice of filing a household's folders under one shared number
the printed sticker bearing the patient's identifier, fixed to each sheet
items.s: Number label: the printed sticker bearing the patient's identifier, fixed to each sheet. The other options describe Serial unit numbering, Family numbering, Serial numbering.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Supervision.
o: the oversight a senior officer gives to the work of juniors
the counting of tasks completed so that staffing can be matched to demand
instruction given to serving staff to improve their current duties
the ordered path of tasks that a folder follows through the department

o: the relative named by a patient to be contacted in an emergency
a second folder opened in error for someone who already has one
the check made against existing names and numbers before a new folder is opened
the officer who records a patient into a bed and opens the inpatient papers

items.q: “a systematic comparison of practice against an agreed standard” is the definition of
o: Audit
Qualitative analysis
Record completion
Quantitative analysis

the ledger in which every entry to and exit from a bed is written in date order

items.q: “the interval between receiving a request and dispatching the answer” is the definition of

Insurance claim form
Turnaround time
Refusal

the check made against existing names and numbers before a new folder is opened
the document such as a card or letter used to confirm who a patient is
the relative named by a patient to be contacted in an emergency

o: the clip or prong that holds the sheets so that none can slip out
the numbered and approved issue of blank documents so that none are unofficial
the measure of how full the jacket has grown before another one must be started

Job description

o: Retrieval

Overdue folder
Missing folder

the oversight a senior officer gives to the work of juniors
the written statement of the duties, limits and reporting line of a post

o: Serial numbering
Number label
Serial unit numbering
Family numbering

the check that entries are accurate, clear and clinically sensible
the finishing of missing entries, signatures and results before filing
a systematic comparison of practice against an agreed standard

o: the keeping of a folder indefinitely because of its legal or research value
the written table that states how long each class of folder is kept
a reduced photographic copy on film used to keep many folders in little space
the destruction of folders that have served out their retention period

items.q: “the patient's signed agreement that named content may be given out” is the definition of

Protected content
Consent to disclose

the grouping of discharged cases by recorded condition for reporting

o: the number of years a folder must remain available before disposal is considered
the cutting of paper into fragments so that the content cannot be read again
the destruction of folders that have served out their retention period
the written table that states how long each class of folder is kept

the fee levied for reproducing folder content for a requester
the interval between receiving a request and dispatching the answer
a court's written command to produce documents or attend as a witness

o: the numbered and approved issue of blank documents so that none are unofficial
the register listing every blank document in use with its stock number
the measure of how full the jacket has grown before another one must be started
a labelled card that separates one section of papers from the next
items.s: Folder volume: the measure of how full the jacket has grown before another one must be started. The other options describe Form control, Form inventory, Divider.

the number of years a folder must remain available before disposal is considered

the average number of days a bed stands empty between one patient and the next

o: the ledger in which every entry to and exit from a bed is written in date order
the total nights of care delivered, found by adding the daily counts over a period
the sheet on which each nursing unit reports its patient movement every morning
the number of beds officially available for use in a unit
items.s: Bed complement: the number of beds officially available for use in a unit. The other options describe Daily ward return, Bed days, Admission and discharge register.

the number of years a folder must remain available before disposal is considered

the ordered path of tasks that a folder follows through the department
the written statement of the duties, limits and reporting line of a post

the pile of folders waiting to be returned because staff are short
a folder returned to a position other than the one its key requires

the fetching of a requested folder from the shelves
